about: A small, hand-written library with questions and session moments whose right answers are known. It scores search and flashback without any inference. The content is generic and invented. Some cases are deliberately hard for word matching, so the scores show its limits.

entries.text: Hard topology spread constraints leave pods pending because the cluster autoscaler ignores pod topology; keep spread constraints soft.
When helm reports another operation in progress, roll back the pending release before retrying the upgrade.
Rollouts hang when a PodDisruptionBudget allows zero disruptions; relax the budget before draining a node.
Terraform plan runs against production unless the staging workspace is selected first.
Spot nodes get a 120 second termination notice; the preemption controller marks their pods within a second.
Image pulls go through the internal registry mirror; pulling from Docker Hub directly is rate limited.
After changing a DNS record wait for the old TTL to expire before testing; the resolver caches negative answers for five minutes.
Rotate a database password by adding the new one in the secret manager, restarting the service, then removing the old one.
Deploy the api by running the database migration job first, then the rollout.
The api service listens on port 8443 behind the internal load balancer.
The api test suite fails unless the TZ environment variable is set to UTC.
The payments integration test is flaky against the sandbox; rerun it once before investigating.
The orders endpoint issues one query per line item unless the items relation is preloaded.
Feature flags are read once at process start; changing a flag needs a restart to take effect.
Every write endpoint must accept an idempotency key; retries without one have double charged customers.
The web app uses pnpm; npm install produces a broken lockfile.
The web build fails when node modules are cached across major Node versions; clear the cache after upgrading Node.
After deploying the web app purge the CDN cache for the index page, or users keep the old bundle.
End-to-end tests need the seed script run against a fresh database before each suite.
Prefer small commits with one logical change each.
Never force push to a shared branch; create a revert commit instead.
CI runs only on pull requests, not on every push.
Run the linter before every commit; CI rejects unformatted code.
Deploys are frozen on Fridays.
The default kubectl context on this machine is a shared production cluster; for local work name the local context with --context devvm.
